title: Joomla site written in another language: every keep slot a visitor reads is translated, a heading split into styled pieces as one phrase (JA Boxing 1.0.4 Vietnamese: THE WORKOUT, Our Classes, Join over 100k…)
steps: S1: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/brief-joomla.test.mjs with the name pattern 'JA Boxing 1.0.4 in Vietnamese' (real JA Boxing j6 1.0.4 contract, About and Name given, languages vi, prepare + apply through the site double)
S2: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/keep-words.test.mjs (grouping of styled pieces, answer checks, fallback)
expect: S1: every keep text slot with letters that is not a fact, a template string, a user or a site setting is written with words other than its English sample; THE|WORKOUT, Our| Classes , Join over |100k| of inspiring creatives and Sign up for the |Boxing| newsletter are each asked as one phrase

selectors.engine: brief-engines/keep-words.js translateKeep, brief-engines/joomla.js keepWords, prepared.translatedKeep, apply keepWritten

evidence: accept-boxing-104-vi.tracy.site, acceptance scan 25/10/2026 (VI class A list)
fence: keep keeps the meaning, never the template's language

cmd: --test-name-pattern=JA Boxing 1.0.4 in Vietnamese|the pieces of one styled heading|an answer keeps each piece|a phrase whose answer cannot be used
tests: the pieces of one styled heading
a phrase whose answer cannot be used
